The Portland Trail Blazers are an American professional basketball team.
The Portland Trail Blazers compete in the National Basketball Association (NBA).
The Portland Trail Blazers are based in Portland, Oregon.
The Portland Trail Blazers play in the Northwest Division of the Western Conference.
The Portland Trail Blazers played their home games in the Memorial Coliseum before moving to the Moda Center in 1995.
